feeds.title: Basketball Giants
feeds.description: Gigantes del Basket is the quintessential basketball magazine in Spain. A historic header that since its birth in 1985 has been punctually attending its monthly appointment with its readers for more than 35 years and is present wherever news related to the sport of baskets is produced. But now, in 2021, Gigantes del Basket is much more than a magazine. They are a group dedicated to information and news about basketball and that seeks to promote the practice of our sport and bring it closer to all corners.
